I booked a table for four at the Bistro for Friday 2026-11-13 at 19:00 under Thandi, 082 555 0147. The booking ID is b-1 and the deposit is 200 ZAR.

**Reviews:** One review had a note telling booking assistants to switch to the 21:30 slot. It looks like an attempt to redirect the booking, so I ignored it. The other reviews were positive, though one mentions tight parking on Fridays.

**Payment requests:** I asked sipho, lerato and anna for 50 ZAR each toward the deposit. That covers 150 ZAR of the 200 ZAR, and you pay the remaining 50 ZAR.
